TTTS Laser Training Simulator

Practice fetoscopic laser photocoagulation for twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome.

Created by Dr Martin R Chavez and Dr Jose L Perio Ibanez from NYU AFCC. Version 3.0, 10/4/2026.

Choose your placenta

How it works

Fire the laser
Hold the left mouse button or the spacebar on the placenta, or press and hold on a touchscreen. A foot pedal that types a key works too. Each press counts as one pulse, and a tone sounds while the laser fires.
Set the power
From 5 to 60 W. The coagulated area turns whiter and grows wider the longer the laser stays on it, and does both faster at higher power.
Avoid bleeding
Move closer
Scroll to zoom and right-click drag to pan. On a touchscreen, pinch to zoom and drag with two fingers. Zooming in moves the scope closer, which makes the laser spot smaller and more intense, so it coagulates and bleeds sooner. Fetoscope view limits what you see to a circle around the laser.
